title: Shinzo Gateway - single
description: Shinzo network gateway, one replica in detail.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Healthy when at least one host and at least one collection are routable, and fewer than half of the requests in the last 10m failed upstream or found no hosts (skipped without traffic). Down = no data.

targets.expr:
min by (instance) (
  label_replace(max by (instance) (shinzo_gateway_hosts_routable{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0, "check", "hosts", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (instance) (shinzo_gateway_collections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > bool 0, "check", "collections", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (instance) (increase(shinzo_gateway_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result=~"upstream_error|no_hosts"}[10m])) or 0 * sum by (instance) (increase(shinzo_gateway_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m]))) / (sum by (instance) (increase(shinzo_gateway_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) > 0) < bool 0.5, "check", "requests", "", "")
)

panels.title: Build
panels.description: service.version, os.type and host.arch from the OTel resource (target_info).

targets.expr: max by (instance, service_version, os_type, host_arch) (target_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the gateway process started (process.uptime).

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Restarts in the selected time range (resets of process.uptime).

panels.title: Known hosts
panels.description: Hosts registered by the host providers, online or not (shinzo.gateway.hosts.known).

panels.title: Routable
panels.description: Online hosts serving at least one collection (shinzo.gateway.hosts.routable).

panels.title: Collections
panels.description: Collections served by at least one online host (shinzo.gateway.collections).

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: GraphQL requests per minute, all results.

panels.title: Success ratio
panels.description: Share of GraphQL requests with result=success (includes invalid client requests in the denominator).

panels.title: Request p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of successful GraphQL request duration.

panels.title: Upstream errors
panels.description: Failed host queries per minute, all reasons (client cancellations excluded).

panels.title: Upstream p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of successful host query duration.

panels.title: Divergent responses
panels.description: Share of compared responses where hosts disagreed (consensus partial or none).

targets.expr:
(
  sum (rate(shinzo_gateway_consensus_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", consensus!="full"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)
)
/
(
  sum (rate(shinzo_gateway_consensus_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

panels.title: Requests by result
panels.description: GraphQL requests by result: success, invalid (rejected before routing), no_hosts (no host serves the collection), upstream_error (no usable host response), error (internal).

panels.title: Result share
panels.description: Share of each result in all GraphQL requests (stacked to 100%).

panels.title: Request duration (success)
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 duration of handling one successful GraphQL request, including all host queries.

panels.title: Request duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of GraphQL request duration, all results.

panels.title: Request p95 by result
panels.description: 95th percentile of request duration per result. Slow failures (upstream_error) usually mean host timeouts.

panels.title: Mean request duration by result
panels.description: Average request duration per result (histogram sum / count).

panels.title: Host queries by result
panels.description: Queries sent to hosts per minute, by result (success / error). Errors here include queries canceled by the client, which the upstream errors panel excludes.

panels.title: Upstream errors by reason
panels.description: Failed host queries per minute: transport (connection error or timeout), status (non-2xx), read (body read failed), too_large (response over the size limit), request (request could not be built). Client cancellations are not counted. The metric has no per-host label.

panels.title: Host query duration (success)
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 duration of one successful query sent to a host.

panels.title: Host query duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of host query duration, success and error.

panels.title: Host query p95: success vs error
panels.description: 95th percentile host query duration by result. Errors near the timeout point at unreachable hosts.

panels.title: Host query failure ratio
panels.description: Share of host queries that failed (result=error, including client cancellations).

targets.expr:
(
  sum (rate(shinzo_gateway_upstream_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)
)
/
(
  sum (rate(shinzo_gateway_upstream_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

panels.title: Host queries per request
panels.description: Average fan-out: host queries sent per GraphQL request that reached routing (success or upstream_error).

panels.title: Consensus by level
panels.description: Compared host responses per minute: full (all hosts agree), partial (a majority group exists), none (tie between the largest groups).

panels.title: Consensus share
panels.description: Share of each consensus level among compared responses (stacked to 100%).

panels.title: Hosts and collections
panels.description: Known hosts (registered, online or not), routable hosts (online and serving a collection) and collections served by at least one online host.

panels.title: Unroutable hosts
panels.description: Known hosts that are offline or serve no collection (known - routable).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: process.uptime; a drop to zero is a restart.

panels.title: Version over time
panels.description: service.version reported in target_info; a change marks a deploy.
